bioAdditions: FamilySearch attaches a New York christening index entry for 'Charity Lamoreau', baptized 27 Mar 1760 at Philipstown (born 26 Jan 1759), and gives her death date as 4 Oct 1848. Her 1820 census entry is as Charity Davenport (S1). The baptism confirms the Philipstown connection of Jean's family.
